Task-change stratum masks combine negative and positive BOLD sign masks with binarization within each task; these paths do not carry the baseline implementation GMmask suffix. Original map/mask membership is still unauthenticated.

In the two-task branch, MEM rows are removed for each CMRO2/OEF criterion first; CALC drop selectors then read the already-filtered MEM frames. The source must not be silently rewritten to CALC-specific selectors.

Separate concordant and discordant models concatenate CALC before MEM, center OEF and CBF percentage-change predictors before missing-row removal, and fit an intercept. The notebook independently drops missing x and y rows before passing them to Pingouin; the statsmodels formula companion is a distinct path under mismatched missingness.
